subject.title: fix: show readable session names across Windows UX

question: Should ordinary Windows session navigation hide all Gateway-classified background families by default while retaining a Show background toggle and keeping an explicitly active background chat selectable?
rationale: This changes established session discoverability beyond fixing opaque names, and automated tests cannot determine the intended Windows product policy.

options.title: Hide Background By Default
options.body: Adopt the filtered default with the explicit toggle and active-session exception after native Windows proof.

options.title: Preserve Existing Visibility
options.body: Land readable titles while retaining current visibility behavior, leaving broader filtering for a separate UX decision.

recommendation.title: Hide Background By Default
recommendation.body: Adopt the filtered default with the explicit toggle and active-session exception after native Windows proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They coordinated the canonical Windows report and both sides of the presentation contract and are the strongest available owner for framing this decision.
